title: Getting Started
description: Understand SHVYA, set up your workspace, and launch a safe first sales conversation.

pages.title: Introduction to SHVYA
pages.summary: What SHVYA does and how CRM, AI, messaging, automation and business tools fit together.
pages.body:
## What is SHVYA AI?
SHVYA is a multi-organization CRM and AI engagement workspace. The CRM is the system of record for leads, stages, activities and ownership. Messaging channels, AI, Cadence, Workflows and Insights operate on those same records.

- **CRM:** pipelines, stages, lead details, custom attributes, import/export and reminders.
- **Channels:** WhatsApp Cloud API, WhatsApp Business App Coexistence, Hosted WhatsApp and Instagram professional messaging.
- **AI Brain:** company information, approved FAQs, knowledge sources, Playbook, languages and guided file sharing.
- **Automation:** Cadence sequences and event-driven Workflows with permission and delivery checks.
- **Customer operations:** SHVYA Sales, SHVYA Calendar, Call Intelligence and Help & Support.
- **Connect Hub:** inbound lead sources, data synchronization, webhooks, Meta attribution and platform integrations.

## How the parts connect
A customer contacts your business or submits an enquiry. The channel or integration identifies the organization, creates or finds the CRM lead, records the source and selects an authorized pipeline. If configured and permitted, the AI responds, asks qualification questions, saves validated evidence and initiates the next action. Your team sees the full journey from the Dashboard.

## Where to begin
1. [Sign in to the Dashboard](/dashboard/login/) and check the active organization.
2. Open the [Quickstart](/docs/getting-started/quickstart/) for a first practical walkthrough.
3. Configure a pipeline, connect one source and test with your own number before a wider rollout.

> Features and configuration rights depend on your subscription, organization policy, connected providers and user role. A visible integration tile does not guarantee the provider is active.

pages.title: Quickstart: your first lead
pages.summary: Connect a channel, prepare AI Brain and verify an end-to-end sample lead.
pages.body:
## Before you start
- A SHVYA login with organization administration rights for setup.
- An active pipeline and at least one stage, normally New Lead.
- A phone or test account you control; do not use a customer's conversation for experiments.
- Provider access if you are connecting WhatsApp or Instagram.

## Step 1 — Prepare your CRM
1. Open [Dashboard](/dashboard/) and confirm your organization and pipeline.
2. Create or verify the New Lead and Qualified stages and describe what each means.
3. Verify the pipeline owner and that its WhatsApp phone matches the number you intend to connect.
4. Add the custom attributes needed for qualification, such as service interest or location.

## Step 2 — Connect one live source
1. For WhatsApp, open [WhatsApp Accounts](/dashboard/whatsapp/accounts/) and choose **API**, **Coexistence** or **Hosted** based on your real setup.
2. Alternatively, open [Connect Hub](/dashboard/connect-hub/) and configure Google Sheets, Meta Lead Ads, JustDial or IndiaMART.
3. Complete provider permissions and select the intended destination pipeline and stage.
4. Confirm the connection is active before testing.

## Step 3 — Configure AI Brain
1. Open **Dashboard → AI Brain / AI Setup**.
2. Save accurate About information, Bot Languages, the AI Playbook and FAQs.
3. Write qualification questions and clear success criteria in the Playbook.
4. Add a knowledge URL or document if needed and verify it has finished processing.
5. Review organization, pipeline, stage and lead AI switches and available credits.

## Step 4 — Test safely
1. Use **AI Sandbox** first to test questions, stage logic and file-sharing conditions without sending real messages.
2. Send a real message from a separate authorized test number to the connected business number.
3. Check that the correct CRM lead, source, pipeline and inbound message appear.
4. Confirm the reply arrives, any mapped attributes are saved and the intended stage change occurs only after the conditions are satisfied.
5. Test a human reply and one follow-up before enabling wider automation.

## What next?
Read [Channels](/docs/messaging-channels/overview/), [AI qualification](/docs/ai-automation/qualification/), and [Troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting/first-checks/).

pages.title: Dashboard navigation
pages.summary: Find CRM, AI Brain, messaging, Connect Hub and team workspaces.
pages.body:
## Main workspaces
- **Dashboard / CRM:** leads, pipelines, stages, imports, exports and reminders.
- **WhatsApp:** connected accounts, channels, Chats, templates and Bulk Campaigns.
- **Instagram:** professional account connection and DM inbox.
- **AI Brain:** Playbook, knowledge sources, FAQs, languages, model settings subject to policy and Sandbox.
- **Sales Desk:** day-to-day sales context and assistance.
- **Cadence:** scheduled follow-up sequences.
- **Workflows:** event triggers, conditions and actions.
- **Insights:** reporting and messaging performance.
- **Connect Hub:** data, email, Meta, marketplace, API and webhook connections.
- **SHVYA Sales / Calendar / Call Intelligence:** document workflows, bookings and Android call tracking.
- **Help & Support:** customer support tickets and replies.

## Find the right control
Open the workspace from the dashboard sidebar. Some actions live inside a lead card, channel account or organization settings rather than appearing as global buttons. If a control is missing, first check your plan and role, then your assigned pipeline.

## Public and signed-in pages
- Public documentation: [shvya-ai.com/docs/](/docs/).
- Product workspace: [Dashboard](/dashboard/).
- Public booking pages are shared by their organization owner; the customer booking link is different from the Calendar editor.
- SHVYA Superadmin screens use a separate privileged account and are not ordinary CRM admin pages.

> Screens may evolve. Use the current page labels and your organization's active features as the authority for what can be changed.

pages.title: Core concepts and lead journey
pages.summary: Learn the terminology SHVYA uses throughout its platform.
pages.body:
## Organization and tenant
An **organization** is the security boundary for CRM records, channels, AI content, files, users and settings. Users can access only the organization and pipelines their permissions allow.

## CRM terms
- **Lead:** a contact or opportunity with source, owner, notes, attributes, stage and activity.
- **Pipeline:** a sales process with its own assigned WhatsApp sender and collection of stages.
- **Stage:** a step in the pipeline, such as New Lead, Qualified or Won.
- **Attribute:** a typed custom field; configured questions may map answers to attributes.
- **Touchpoint / Quick Reply:** reusable human-facing text or attachment snippets.
- **Cadence:** a sequence of time-based follow-up actions.
- **Workflow:** an event plus conditions that launches a validated action.

## AI terms
- **AI Brain:** the organization's saved company context, Playbook, knowledge, FAQs and related AI settings.
- **Playbook:** operational rules for welcome, questions, qualification, mapping and handoff.
- **AI Sandbox:** a simulation that previews a conversation and supported actions without sending messages to customers.
- **AI Trace:** diagnostic evidence for a specific AI turn.
- **Knowledge source:** a processed approved webpage or uploaded document that can ground an answer.

## Messaging terms
- **WhatsApp API:** Meta Cloud API-managed number and webhook messaging.
- **Coexistence:** supported WhatsApp Business App connection that shares Cloud API transport.
- **Hosted:** linked-device session managed through SHVYA's hosted gateway, with different connection and queue behavior.
- **24-hour service window:** the Meta API rule governing free-form WhatsApp messages after a customer inbound.

[Continue with CRM](/docs/crm-leads/overview/) or [AI Brain](/docs/ai-automation/ai-brain/).

pages.title: Roles, plans and permissions
pages.summary: Understand who can configure integrations and which access checks govern leads.
pages.body:
## Access model
- **Organization Admin:** organization configuration and administrative actions allowed by the subscription and platform policy.
- **Agent / team member:** day-to-day work within the pipelines and actions explicitly assigned to the user.
- **SHVYA Superadmin:** cross-organization platform operations, special integration provisioning and platform-level policy control.

## Pipeline boundaries
A non-admin user may see only assigned pipelines. The server rechecks authorization when a lead is viewed, moved, exported, deleted, or messaged. Access to a CRM page is not proof that every operation in it is permitted.

## Provider and feature controls
Connection permissions, channel health, approval state, allowed WhatsApp sender, AI toggles and available credits are separate requirements. A saved feature setting is not equivalent to successful provider delivery.

## Common setup mistakes
- Inviting an agent but not assigning a pipeline.
- Connecting a phone number that does not match the target pipeline's sender.
- Expecting an organization admin to generate a Superadmin-only JustDial or IndiaMART webhook.
- Expecting a restricted module to appear on a plan that does not include it.

## Resolve missing access
1. Confirm you signed into the intended organization.
2. Ask the organization admin to check plan and pipeline permissions.
3. Check that the channel or integration is enabled and approved.
4. Raise a [Help & Support ticket](/docs/operations/support-tickets/) if the authorized action is still blocked.

pages.title: Go-live checklist
pages.summary: A short acceptance checklist before turning on campaigns and live automation.
pages.body:
## Verify records and permissions
- Confirm the correct organization, pipeline, stage and lead owner.
- Create and re-open a test lead; verify attributes, notes, source and timestamps.
- Verify agent access, especially on cross-pipeline moves and exports.

## Verify messages and AI
- Confirm an inbound chat appears in the intended account and lead.
- Confirm provider send, acknowledgement and delivery are distinguished; queued does not mean sent.
- Test AI Brain in Sandbox and at least one authorized real channel conversation.
- Confirm qualification requires evidence, not an unanswered question or an AI assertion.
- Check languages, file-sharing conditions, FAQ grounding and human handoff.

## Verify automations
- Test Cadence once with realistic timing and an inbound reply.
- Verify templates are approved for API messages outside the service window.
- Confirm Workflows do not send from a different pipeline's number.

## Verify connected systems
- Send one test enquiry from each source: Meta Leads, Sheets, JustDial or IndiaMART where applicable.
- Verify calendar slot availability and a confirmed booking.
- Preview a SHVYA Sales PDF before sending an invoice or agreement.
- Check the Support portal and your team escalation contact.

## Operational sign-off
Keep the test lead IDs, timestamp, channel, expected result and observed result. If any critical step remains unverified, do not describe it as live-tested. [Troubleshooting guide](/docs/troubleshooting/first-checks/).
